design.audience: Solo tactical players who need to preserve already accepted decisions and knowingly choose whether to resume an older journal, start over or quit.
portfolio_comparison: P02 0.2.1 already pins evaluator source; independent candidate/context evidence remains absent.
P04 0.3.0 already revises demonstrated agency/mechanism issues; further reader/source work needs a concrete weakness.
P03/P06 physical practice and unassisted learning remain credible needs, but another synthetic feature cannot establish those outcomes.
P11 0.8.0 handovers remain valuable; JSON export session-guard concern is source-supported, not an executed defect.
P05 failed-save navigation has directly reproducible accepted-progress loss and an available native consumer.
alternatives: Warning only explains a loss without preserving it.
Blocking every departure traps a permanently unavailable save path.
Selected: verified portable journal copies, explicit Open run and keep/retry/copy/discard decisions; retain the working native product.
design.implementation: Preservation token tracks the exact accepted journal last written/read back/replayed or loaded from a valid source. A new action becomes unpreserved after write failure. Navigation validates candidates before and after the leave decision; successful recovery cancels queued navigation. Dialogs block hidden turn/selection controls. A copy cannot target the normalized primary path. Future actions keep the primary destination and leave source copies intact.
design.creative_assessment: Codex assessment: protects consequences already chosen across a three-encounter rescue while retaining optional tactical response feedback and manually paced enemies. Recovery UI makes deliberate loss explicit. No rule, balance, literary, art or musical improvement is claimed.

refinements_and_failures: Long path success/error messages initially failed the existing clipping assertion; concise status text retains full detail in tooltips. Assertions were preserved.
Wrapped native dialog labels grew excessively in actual frames, even after an explicit popup height. A bounded scrolling RichTextLabel removes the height feedback.

Two earlier project extractions failed the combined changed-source guard assertion. Instrumented source and a clean diagnostic extraction passed without gameplay changes; that result alone did not establish a product or environment cause. Fixtures now wait a frame and require a visible chooser before selection, retaining all state-loss assertions. Final fresh project/player checks pass.

Full-screen OCR readiness polling wasted time, and fixed startup delays sent input to black/splash screens during concurrent work. Cropped opening-button readiness and direct PNG/file inspection distinguish startup from product behavior.

Restricted-network baseline and current NuGet restores both failed NU1900. Normal supported network permission restored audited builds, without disabling audit or warnings. Missing writable CLI/XDG paths and a transient exec-server disconnect were environmental, recovered without product workarounds.

x11_close_boundary.current_observed: After verified copy, an initialized actual player ignored two synthetic WM_DELETE_WINDOW requests; fresh tree confirmed main window 0x200003. WM_PROTOCOLS advertised WM_STATE. Owned timeout supervisor eventually stopped the preview.
x11_close_boundary.assessment: Ready exact 0.4.0 baseline reproduces the unhandled request under the same Xorg setup. Cause is not established; no recovery-product change or assertion weakening was made. Native CloseRequested/keep guards and QuitCleanly execute in engine checks; normal desktop WM close remains unverified.

limits: Synthetic implementing-agent control, technical comparison and visual judgment; no independent human recovery, learning, enjoyment or demand evidence.
One primary autosave with manually chosen recovery files; no multi-slot index, cloud sync, undo or automatic archive.
Preservation is verified at that moment; later external deletion, simultaneous process writes and power-loss durability are not guaranteed.
Linux x86_64 execution only; physical audio, assistive technology and other operating systems unverified.

north_star.claim: Independent origin-product development; no adaptation/integration or capability promotion.

prompt_review.reason: Current artifact comparison, failure/baseline distinction and bounded process guidance served the design; no new general rule or fixed project priority is justified.
